fullDescription: A premium, influencer-scale wellness app design featuring a warm 'peachy cream' palette, editorial-grade serif typography, and sophisticated glassmorphism elements. Optimized for high-end meditation, health coaching, and luxury lifestyle verticals. Characterized by soft #FFF9F5 backgrounds, #FF8DA1 rose accents, and high-contrast Playfair Display headings. Includes bento-style cards, circular progress metrics, and a refined mood selector with grayscale-to-color hover states.

structured.summary: A luxurious mobile-first wellness dashboard that balances soft, caring warmth with high-end editorial aesthetics through the use of serif fonts, layered shadows, and a sophisticated peachy-pink color palette.

style.description: The style uses a pairing of 'Playfair Display' (serif) for headlines and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (sans-serif) for body text. The primary background is #FFF9F5, accented with #FF8DA1 (Rose) and #F5E6E0 (Border). UI elements feature heavy rounding (up to 40px), soft wide shadows, and glassmorphic overlays.
style.prompt: Create a high-end luxury aesthetic using a background color of #FFF9F5. Typography: Headings in 'Playfair Display' (Bold/Black weight, #3D3D3D), Body and labels in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Medium/Semi-bold, #5D5D5D). Primary Accent: #FF8DA1 (Rose). Secondary Accents: #FFB0BB (Pastel Pink), #A78BFA (Lavender), #FBBF24 (Amber). UI Elements: Use a border-radius of 32px to 40px for major containers. Shadows: Apply 'premium-shadow' (box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -5px rgba(245, 230, 224, 0.5)). Glassmorphism: Use 'card-glass' (background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)). Animations: Smooth transitions (300ms) on hover/active states with subtle scale(0.98) on click.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling mobile layout (max-width 375px) with a persistent bottom navigation bar and a generous 28px padding (px-7) for content. Sections are clearly separated by large 40px margins.

prompts.prompt: A greeting area at the top. On the left, a two-line text block: a large 3xl Playfair Display greeting (#3D3D3D) above a small text-sm subtitle (#8D8D8D). On the right, a 48x48px square button with 16px border-radius, white background, containing a #FFB0BB icon.

A 220px tall full-width card with 40px rounded corners. It features a background image with a layered gradient overlay (bottom-to-top: black/50 to transparent). Bottom-left: Headline (Playfair, 2xl, white) and subtitle (Sans, sm, opacity 90%). Top-right: A glassmorphic 'Featured' badge with 10px font size, uppercase, tracking-widest, and white text.

A horizontally scrolling row of pills. Each pill: white background, 1px border (#F5E6E0), 24px-32px rounded corners, padding 14px 20px. Inside: a 32px icon container with a specific pastel background (e.g., #FFF1F3) and a matching colored icon, followed by text-sm font-semibold (#5D5D5D).

A white container with 32px rounding and a #F5E6E0 border. Top row: 'Playfair Display' title and a small #FF8DA1 'Progress' link with a chevron. Content: A large 80px circular progress SVG (stroke-width 6px, #FF8DA1 track, #FDF2F0 rail) with center percentage text, placed side-by-side with a summary text block (2xl font for the score, xs for description).

Centered section with a Playfair title. Five buttons arranged in a row. Each button contains a 36px emoji and an 11px uppercase label (#8D8D8D). Micro-interaction: Emojis are grayscale by default, turning full color and scaling up slightly on hover/active state.

A fixed 375px nav bar with white background and 40px bottom padding (safe area). Active item: Features a rounded-2xl #FFE8EC background 'pill' around the icon and #FF8DA1 coloring. Inactive items: #7D7D7D color with text-xs labels and 24px icons. Subtle top border: 1px solid #F5E6E0.

special_ui_components.description: A refined SVG-based progress ring for tracking wellness goals.
special_ui_components.prompt: SVG circle with 80x80px dimensions. Stroke width of 6px. Base rail: #FDF2F0. Progress stroke: #FF8DA1 with 'round' stroke-linecap. Center: Absolute-positioned text in Plus Jakarta Sans, bold, #3D3D3D. Use stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset for percentage calculation.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive mood selection buttons that transition from muted to vibrant.
special_ui_components.prompt: Vertical flex container. Top element: Emoji span with 'filter: grayscale(100%)' transition. On hover/active: 'filter: grayscale(0%)' and 'transform: scale(1.1)'. Bottom element: 11px uppercase label with 0.1em tracking-widest.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the 'Playfair Display' for all semantic headers to preserve the editorial feel. MUST: Use #FFF9F5 as the primary background; pure white (#FFFFFF) should only be used for elevated cards and pills. NOT: Do not use sharp corners; minimum radius for cards is 32px. NOT: Do not use black (#000000) for text; use #3D3D3D for high contrast and #8D8D8D for secondary text.
